---
# Cards are generated from each post's frontmatter by ../_blog-card.ejs, using
# the same card styles as the Projects page. Per-post fields it reads: title,
# description, categories (shown as tags) and date (sort order only; the date
# is shown on the post itself, not on the card).
title: "Blog"
page-layout: full
# Card titles are <h3>; without this, anchor-sections nests an <a> inside the
# card's own <a>, which is invalid HTML.
anchor-sections: false
listing:
  - id: posts
    template: ../_blog-card.ejs
    contents:
      - posts/*.md
      # Drafts: remove as each post is published (see _quarto.yml).
      - "!posts/0[679]_*.md"
    sort: "date desc"
---

Hello! Welcome to the blog portion of my website. 

I will use this space to keep track of ideas and helpful tips and tricks that I come across or that I have gathered from my career so far and create posts about interesting topics that I want to deep dive or dismantle.

Every post carries one of three tags, so you can tell at a glance what kind of thing it is:

- [Tool]{.project-tag .project-tag--tool} — a tool or resource: what it does and how it could help you.
- [Tips]{.project-tag .project-tag--tips} — advice and tips I've picked up so far.
- [Topic]{.project-tag .project-tag--topic} — an explainer on a subject, written up for someone coming to it fresh.

I almost certainly will make some mistakes, so please feel free to send any comments, corrections or suggestions to me by email.

::: {#posts}
:::
